title: fix(lint,metadata-core): a skill's context naming a pack a declared dependency ships no longer warns; the ADR-0150 D3 rule moves to metadata-core
body:
Fixes #37609

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：技能作者在应用的技能里引用一个由所依赖的应用包提供的资料包时，发布前的校验不再误报「资料包不存在」；真正不存在或未声明依赖的资料包照旧提示，并说明该怎么改。
- 为什么做：属于「AI 技能与资料包」专题的收尾，让校验工具和运行时用同一条规则判断技能指向哪个资料包。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是校验提示比运行时多报或少报一条警告，不影响运行时行为，也不拒绝任何配置；回退本改动即可恢复原状。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **The ADR-0150 D3 rule moves to `@objectstack/metadata-core`.** `resolvePackageScopedHolders`, its holder source, refusal, `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` and vocabulary (`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, which imports nothing) move with `git mv` to `packages/metadata-core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, beside the closure walk it reads (`package-closure.ts`), together with its test file. metadata-core's index exports it. This follows the R2 precedent that moved the closure walk out of lint into metadata-core. No new package edge: metadata-core depends only on spec, and core, lint, objectql and metadata-protocol already depend on it (seat ruling 7205321128, route A).
- **Core re-exports every name.** `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts` is now one named re-export of the 33 names (20 values, 13 types) from `@objectstack/metadata-core`, so core's export set, every core caller (objectql, mcp `skill-prompts.ts`, cli `picklist-references.ts`, core's security catalog) and every `path#symbol` anchor into that file are unchanged. There is no second copy.
- **`ai-skill-context-unknown` judges `context` by that rule** (`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts`, `skillContextResolver`). Holders are the stack's own packs and the packs of the artifact's other `packages[]` bodies. The closure is `packageResolutionClosure` over those packages: declared dependencies, transitively, plus `sys`. The caller is the stack's `manifest.id`. This is the shape the CLI's per-package pass already hands each package (`packageBodyAsStack`), so `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` give the answer the MCP skill prompt gives (`skillPromptRecordContext`):
  - a pack a declared dependency in the artifact ships: no warning (the false positive this card measured);
  - the stack's own pack: no warning, as before;
  - a pack no package in the artifact ships: the same warning and wording as before;
  - a pack only a sibling outside the closure ships: warns, naming the holder, with the hint to declare the dependency;
  - a pack two holders in reach ship: warns, naming both.
  Each verdict is one line of at most 200 characters.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/lint`, all patch, with the two declaration lines.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`: the re-export must list every name the moved module exports; the identity pin holds the value set.
2. `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts`, `skillContextResolver`: the holder set and closure handed to the rule.
3. `packages/metadata-core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`: only the placement header changed; the rest is a byte-for-byte move.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution-reexport.test.ts` (new): each of the 20 values core re-exports is the same object (`toBe`) as metadata-core's, through the module and core's index. The value set equals the pre-move set. A refusal error built by one package is `instanceof` the other's class.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts`, a new describe in the per-package stack shape: dependency pack 0, own-stack 0, truly unknown 1, non-dependency sibling 1, two holders in the closure 1, and the one-line bound.
- The rule's own 100+ arm tests moved unchanged with the file into metadata-core.

All suites below were run at `14b930039a`.

<details><summary>Ablation: drop the closure argument</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts --anchor '      closureOf,' --replacement '      () => new Set...(),'`. The mutation hands the rule an empty closure. The lint suite imports the rule from `src`, so no dist leg is needed.

```text
ablation-replace: anchor   x1 -> x0
ablation-replace: blob     bb3e3db3a3ac -> abe67df5aa7f
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed

  Tests  1 failed | 42 passed (43)

ablation-replace: blob at HEAD        bb3e3db3a3acefa940e770e3e4e811488b805af5
```

Only the dependency pin goes red. The controls stay green.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 69 derived)</summary>

66 exit 0. Two exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, so NOT MEASURED; CI builds them): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:published-readme-exports`. `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3, then exited 0 after the objectql closure was built: "Admitted set held exactly (15 packages)". `check:adr-symbol-anchors` exit 0: "4243 anchors across 163 records resolve". `--ran` reconciliation: 69 derived, 69 run, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Overlap: #37676 adds 'knowledge_source' to the core file this PR moves; the second lander re-homes the entry into metadata-core (area decision, zone told)
- Out of scope, not edited (docs/adr is fenced and governed): an ADR-0150 amendment note still names the pin path `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`, which this PR moves to `packages/metadata-core/src/`. The area seat carries it.
- A dependency outside the artifact (installed from npm) ships packs `os validate` cannot read, so a `context` naming one still gets the hedged "unless a dependency ships it" warning.

## Verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts`. Expect 43 passed, including "a pack a declared dependency ships resolves: no warning".
